evidence: Add Transaction dialog has text input fields (Description, Amount, Reference, Notes) and successfully created a new expense record "Future Test Expense" that appeared in the transactions table.
Dashboard page (/) loads and displays Total Balance, Monthly Income, Monthly Expenses, Net Profit/Loss cards, Income vs Expenses chart, Expenses by Category chart, and Recent Transactions list.
Typing "Adobe" into the Transactions search box filtered the table to show only the "Software Subscription - Adobe CC" row.

Selecting "Rent" in the Category filter combobox correctly restricted the table to only the two Rent transactions (Dec 2 and Nov 2, 2024). Date range From/To filters also correctly restricted results to the selected range.
Using "Add Transaction" dialog, filled Date/Description/Amount/Category and clicked "Add Expense" — new row "Future Test Expense" -$100.00 appeared in the transactions table and totals updated.

Clicked edit button on the "Future Test Expense" row, changed description to "Future Test Expense - Edited" and toggled Tax Related, clicked "Update Expense" — row updated in place with new description and tax checkmark.
The Add/Edit Transaction dialog includes a required Category dropdown (e.g. Office Supplies, Rent, Software, etc.) which is saved and displayed in the transaction's Category column.
Edit dialog allowed changing description, amount, category, date, and tax-related flag; changes were reflected immediately in the transactions table.
Clicking "Add Expense" with all fields empty (except default date and type) did not create a record — dialog remained open and no new row was added to the transactions table.

issue: App allows creating a transaction with a future date with no validation or warning.
actual: Set Date to 2027-01-01 (future relative to current date 2026-09-02), filled Description/Amount/Category, and clicked "Add Expense". The transaction was created successfully and appeared in the table as "Jan 1, 2027 Future Test Expense -$100.00" with no error or blocking message.

issue: Date filter does not validate or warn when the "From" date is later than the "To" date.
actual: Set From: 2024-12-31 and To: 2024-12-01 (start later than end). The app silently returned "No transactions found - Try adjusting your filters" with no explicit error message explaining the invalid date range, and did not prevent or correct the invalid input.

evidence: Search keyword "Adobe", Category filter "Rent", and Date range 2024-12-01 to 2024-12-31 each produced result sets that strictly matched the selected criteria (verified row-by-row).

Toggling "Tax Related" switch to on in the Edit dialog and saving updated the Tax column in the transactions table to show a ✓ checkmark for that row, confirming visible feedback of the tax-related marking.

issue: Print Report produces no observable in-app document/print preview or selection UI.
actual: Clicked \"Print Report\" button on Tax Summary page. No dialog, modal, new tab, or any change appeared in the accessibility tree/DOM. Console messages showed no print-related output, only pre-existing unrelated warnings. There is no in-app \"document selection menu\" showing the printed report — the button appears to only trigger a native OS print dialog (if anything), which is not verifiable or observable within the application's DOM.

evidence: Clicked \"Add Category\" on Categories page, filled name \"Test Category\" and chose a color, clicked save — new category \"Test Category\" appeared in the categories list with 0 transactions/$0 total initially.

After adding \"IX18 Test Expense\" ($250, dated Sep 2 2026) via Transactions page and navigating to Dashboard via in-app link (no reload), Monthly Expenses, Net Profit/Loss, and Recent Transactions immediately reflected the new record without requiring a manual refresh.

After creating \"Test Category\" and assigning it to the new \"IX18 Test Expense\" transaction, the Categories page updated to show \"Test Category\" with \"1 transactions\" and a \"$250\" total, correctly reflecting the already-assigned record.

Toggled \"Tax Related\" switch ON when creating \"IX18 Test Expense\"; the transaction subsequently appeared in the Tax Summary page's \"All Tax-Related Transactions\" table, confirming the tax-related marking is persisted and surfaced correctly.

After adding the $250 \"IX18 Test Expense\", Dashboard's Monthly Expenses and Net Profit/Loss (-$250 delta) exactly matched the entered transaction amount, confirming dashboard figures match actual entered financial data.

Transactions page lists all individual spending records with amounts/categories/dates; Categories page shows per-category totals; Tax Summary page shows \"Deductible Expenses by Category\" breakdown — together these give users clear visibility into spending and expenditure details.

issue: Summary tables are viewable but no functional print capability is present/verifiable.
actual: Reports page (/reports) displays financial summary data (Total Income, Total Expenses, Net Profit/Loss, Daily Activity, Income/Expenses by Category) confirming users CAN view basic financial summary tables. However, the Reports page itself has no print button/control, and the only print-related control found in the app (Tax Summary's \"Print Report\" button, tested under IX-19) produced no observable in-app print preview, document output, or confirmation when clicked. Therefore the \"print\" half of this requirement could not be verified as functional.
